architecture.mechanism: Secondary flow patterns (Dean vortices) induced by tubing curvature that enhance momentum transfer and reduce effective frictional resistance in turbulent flow.
architecture.intervention: Introduce a controlled, tight-pitch helical coil geometry to the multi-lumen tubing shaft to induce Dean vortices within each lumen without increasing the outer profile diameter.
architecture.expected_effect: Reduction in frictional pressure loss per unit length for a given flow rate compared to straight multi-lumen tubing of identical inner diameter and profile.
architecture.falsification_test: Measure pressure drop across coiled versus straight multi-lumen tubing samples of equal length and inner/outer diameters using water at Reynolds numbers >4000; failure is confirmed if the coiled sample exhibits equal or higher pressure drop.
